texte.Ce cadre n'est pas certifiable : aucun o: This framework is not certifiable: no body issues an attestation against it. The rate measures the coverage you declare, and nothing more — presenting it as compliance would be a fault before a client as before an insurer.
texte.Ce projet de norme n'est pas encore cité: This draft standard is not yet cited in the Official Journal of the European Union under Regulation (EU) #/#: meeting it opens no presumption of conformity with Article #.
texte.Ce score dit que ce que la norme attend: This score says what the standard expects is declared and that the reaction-time arithmetic holds. It does not amount to a presumption of conformity: the presumption of conformity with Article # will arise only on the day the standard's reference is cited in the Official Journal of the European Union under Regulation (EU) #/#. That is not the case today: the draft is at CEN Enquiry stage.
